attributes.action: Cica same roof rule uk and iicsa recommendations regarding compensation/support
attributes.additional_details: Many victims have been retraumatised and further damaged doing compensation decades after being victims of convicted familial child abuse in their childhoods.
attributes.background: Because the UK governments destroyed victims criminal case files in the transition from paper to digital filing in the 1990's no funding was provided to support victims of the cica same roof rule uk compensation scandal. 2 of the 20 iicsa recommendations directly relate to this situation.

rejection.details:
I'm afraid we find it unclear from your wording exactly what you are calling for in your petition. Perhaps you want the Government to speed up compensation payments, or to provide them even when evidence is lacking because of the destruction of relevant records?

We can consider a petition on this subject if the text makes more clear what it is you are seeking.
